decisions.decision: Director Noble cancelled all further Dine Around activities until further notice, after finding only half of participants were Lunenburg residents/regular clients and observing intoxication at functions.
decisions.quote: ms. noble has cancelled all further dine around activities until further notice.

decisions.decision: Director sent a letter to the Lunenburg bus trip coordinator: stop representing trips as run by the Town/COA/Eagle House, all further postings suspended, materials returned, no further disruption of others' information.
decisions.quote: all further postings of her trips have been suspended

decisions.decision: Director will contact the Town Manager about extending the temporary Outreach Coordinator's time.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will contact the town manager regarding extending the temporary outreach coordinator's time.

decisions.decision: Senior van may be used for a Quilting Bus Trip only after senior center operating hours and only if a van driver is willing to come in after hours.
decisions.quote: ms. noble responded that this would only be possible after senior center operating hours and only if one of the van drivers was willing to come in after hours to do so.

decisions.decision: Board members volunteered to participate in task groups (Advocacy, Communication, Public Relations) as needed.
decisions.quote: board members discussed the roles of individual task groups as follows and members volunteered to participate as needed

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Twelve people participated; each will receive a deduction off the property tax bill of between the amounts stated; program restarts January 2015.
budget_items.quote: there were 12 people who participated and they will be receiving anywhere between $750-$1000 deducted off of their property tax bill.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director hopes funding can be made available to hire another All Purpose staff person, but feels the biggest need is another Meal Site Coordinator; Finance Committee wants next year's budget prepared by end of January.
budget_items.quote: ms. noble is hoping that funding could be made available to the coa to hire another "all purpose" staff person but she feels the biggest need at this time is hiring another meal site coordinator.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New flooring was installed at the Eagle House as part of the FY2015 Capital Plan process; no cost figure printed.
budget_items.quote: new tile flooring/carpeting has been installed at the eagle house. this was all part of the fy2015 capital plan process.
